title: Universal 4-Part Pedagogical Card Invariant
description: The four part structural invariant mapping inputs, processing mechanics, verifiable outputs, and senior insights across every academic domain.

tier_1_input.definition: The exact stimulus, request, raw data, legal scenario, economic shock, or exam question.
tier_1_input.tech_domain: HTTP Method, Request URL, Headers, and Raw JSON Body
tier_1_input.law_domain: Facts of the dispute, statutory section, and petitioner prayer
tier_1_input.economics_domain: Market shock, supply shift, policy interest rate change
tier_1_input.math_domain: Initial condition, theorem hypothesis, input matrix

tier_2_under_the_hood.definition: The step by step transformation pipeline, internal machinery, and causal mechanism.
tier_2_under_the_hood.tech_domain: TCP socket buffering, stream chunking, express.json() deserialization, routing table lookup
tier_2_under_the_hood.law_domain: Constitutional bench interpretation, judicial doctrine, precedence analysis
tier_2_under_the_hood.economics_domain: Equilibrium adjustment, price clearing mechanism, velocity multiplier
tier_2_under_the_hood.math_domain: Successive algebraic proof transformations, matrix row reductions

tier_3_output.definition: The verifiable, observable terminal outcome, status, response, or verdict.
tier_3_output.tech_domain: HTTP Status Code (e.g. 201 Created), Response Headers, and JSON response payload
tier_3_output.law_domain: Operative order, writ remedy, declared legal precedent
tier_3_output.economics_domain: New market clearing price, welfare distribution, deadweight loss
tier_3_output.math_domain: Q.E.D. final derived equation, eigenvalue set, geometric graph

tier_4_senior_savior.definition: The mentor defensive insight, production edge case warning, or exam winning rubric.
tier_4_senior_savior.tech_domain: Sameer defensive architecture rule, silent failure avoidance, wire inspection habit
tier_4_senior_savior.law_domain: Senior Advocate courtroom strategy, doctrine exception, dissenting opinion hook
tier_4_senior_savior.economics_domain: Unintended consequences warning, inflation expectation trap, elasticity limit
tier_4_senior_savior.math_domain: Singularity trap warning, boundary condition check, shortcut mnemonic
